results.title: Empowering the Workforce in the Context of a Skills-First ...
results.content: Skills-first practices can help employers broaden their talent pools and enable individuals to access opportunities which they were previously not able to [(OECD, 2024[1])](/en/publications/empowering-the-workforce-in-the-context-of-a-skills-first-approach_345b6528-en/full-report/practical-considerations-for-a-skills-first-approach_88eb89d7.html#Kapp_f35da44f_980e24ff36). In many hiring processes, degree requirements serve not only as a signal of the skills associated with the course or field of study, but also as a proxy for transversal skills associated with higher education [(Economist Impact, 2023[3])](/en/publications/empowering-the-workforce-in-the-context-of-a-skills-first-approach_345b6528-en/full-report/practical-considerations-for-a-skills-first-approach_88eb89d7.html#Eco23_980e24ff36), often having the effect of filtering out individuals who do not conform to traditional signalling methods [(Demaria, 2020[4])](/en/publications/empowering-the-workforce-in-the-context-of-a-skills-first-approach_345b6528-en/full-report/practical-considerations-for-a-skills-first-approach_88eb89d7.html#Dem20_980e24ff36). By reducing reliance on degree requirements, employers can focus on individuals who have gained the necessary skills through alternative routes, regardless of their educational qualifications or prior work experience [(DeMark, 2022[6])](/en/publications/empowering-the-workforce-in-the-context-of-a-skills-first-approach_345b6528-en/full-report/practical-considerations-for-a-skills-first-approach_88eb89d7.html#Sar22_980e24ff36). The skills-first approach enables individuals who have developed strong skills through non-traditional means – such as work experiences, self-learning or through acquiring microcredentials – to be considered for roles where they would be typically overlooked through degree-centric hiring practices [(Blair et al., 2020[5])](/en/publications/empowering-the-workforce-in-the-context-of-a-skills-first-approach_345b6528-en/full-report/practical-considerations-for-a-skills-first-approach_88eb89d7.html#CrossRef_dYfGcTjNFvENfPagZaxlAw_980e24ff36).
